shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
cat package.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; head -c 1500 package-lock.json 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "---"; node -v 2>/dev/null; npm -v 2>/dev/null

for f in src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== node_modules top"; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json');console.log(p.version, p.main, p.module)" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@tanstack; grep -o '"[A-Za-z]*":' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -100

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls Table Pagination Checkbox && cat Table/index.d.ts && cat Table/Table.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ----; cat Pagination/Pagination.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; echo ----; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -80

ls Table/hoc && cat Table/hoc/index.d.ts && cat Table/hoc/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat Pagination/types.d.ts; echo ----; cat Pagination/Pagination.js | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc && cat withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts && echo ---- && cat withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts && echo ---- && sed -n 1,200p withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150
cat withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -140; echo ----; cat withTableSorting/SortIndicator/SortIndicator.d.ts; cat withTableSorting/SortIndicator/SortIndicator.js | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table && grep -n "static getRowId" -A 12 Table.js; echo ----; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "Table\|Pagination\|Checkbox" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; sed -n 140,175p ../esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; echo ----; grep -n "selected\|classNames" ../esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head; echo ----; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite|vitest)$"; npx tsc -v
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" ; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom"; ls /usr/lib/node_modules 2>/dev/null) ; echo done

cp package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && cp package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && timeout 240 npm i --no-save jsdom@25 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -5; ls node_modules | grep -c . ; node -e "require('jsdom'); console.log('jsdom ok')"; git status --short
timeout 200 npx vitest run src/__check__.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -120

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/__check__.test.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("(globalThis as any).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true;",
"(globalThis as any).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true;\n(globalThis as any).ResizeObserver = class { observe() {} unobserve() {} disconnect() {} };\n(globalThis as any).matchMedia ??= () => ({ matches: false, addListener() {}, removeListener() {}, addEventListener() {}, removeEventListener() {} });",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 200 npx vitest run --config vitest.check.config.mts 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -90
timeout 200 npx vitest run --config vitest.check.config.mts 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -90

rm -f src/__check__.test.tsx vitest.check.config.mts && rm -rf dist && timeout 200 npm uninstall --no-save jsdom 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; cmp -s package.json /tmp/pkg.bak && echo "package.json unchanged" || echo "package.json CHANGED"; cmp -s package-lock.json /tmp/lock.bak && echo "lock unchanged" || { echo "lock changed, restoring"; cp /tmp/lock.bak package-lock.json; }; git status --short; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "tsc exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
